Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.g@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + scheduling the demo

Hi Marissa 

Great to meet today  really appreciate you walking through Redwood’s marketplace integration approach. As discussed, the next best step is a partner-led technical demo that includes our marketplace PM (Alicia) and Redwood’s runtime/infra tech lead so we can validate deployment flows + SSO/KMS details.

A few proposed times (PDT):
- Wed 3/24 10:0011:00
- Wed 3/24 15:0016:00
- Thu 3/25 09:0010:00

Would any of these work for your team? I’ve attached a short draft agenda and the MoU we usually start from (PDF stub). If you prefer, we can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Notes for the demo: we want to cover marketplace listing flow, private deployment options (VPC), and a quick pass on billing/contracting milestones.

Thanks  look forward to locking a time.

 Sanjay
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge

Attachments: CloudBridge-MoU.pdf, partner-demo-agenda.docx

Agenda suggestions from Redwood:
- 5m intros + roles
- 20m marketplace listing & integration flow (Alicia + Sanjay)
- 20m runtime/SSO/KMS/priv infra (Ben)
- 10m Q&A + next-steps (contracts / MoU owner)

Can you confirm Wed 3/24 15:00 PT and send an invite? Also, can you share any tenant/SSO test accounts beforehand if you want us to validate end-to-end?

 Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

P.S. I added a short Redwood demo agenda doc (redwood-demo-agenda.md) to this thread for Ben/Mateo to review.
